content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — Elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate in us-east-1 (service: redwood-api). Current anomaly started ~15m ago. Paging primary on-call. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/12345

Charlie O: taking this as primary. on-call window: I'm primary until 08:00 UTC. Ben P is secondary.

Alice J: thanks — quick handoff notes:
- Observed spike in decode latency leading to CPU OOM in inference pool node set "infer-g4dn-1".
- Autoscaler didn't kick due to max-pool-size == 12 (hit cap).

Charlie O: checklist I ran:
1) Quick health checks:
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/health
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=redwood-infer -o wide
```
2) Scaled fallback nodes to qty=4 (t2) and drained 2 suspect pods.
3) Applied temporary routing rule to steer 20% traffic to us-west-2.

Ben P: I can jump in to look at autoscaler config + metrics. Noted potential coverage gap tonight 02:00-04:00 PT where no secondary is scheduled (roster mismatch).

Eve S: customer impact — two customers reported increased error rates (acct-758 and acct-911). Support already opened SEV tickets. Linking internal tickets: https://support.redwood/internal/t/ACCT-758 and /ACCT-911

Charlie O: runbook pointer — follow the "Deployment OOM / Autoscale" section: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/oom-autoscale
Excerpt: 
```
If inference pod OOM/eviction observed:
1. Check pod logs: kubectl logs -n inference <pod> --previous
2. Increase pool capacity: sh ./infra/scale_pool.sh --pool infer-g4dn-1 --add 2
3. If autoscaler at max, update temp max with: infractl autoscale update --pool infer-g4dn-1 --max 16 --reason "emergency: P1"
```

Sam (SRE): noted. I executed infractl update to bump max to 16 temporarily. Verified autoscaler accepted change (events show scaling activity). Also created a deploy lock for new model rollouts in us-east-1 to avoid additional load: `infractl lock deploy --region us-east-1 --reason "P1 mitigation"`

Alice J: mitigation status: :white_check_mark: 5xx rate down from 6.2% -> 1.1% over 12m after traffic shift + scale. Latency back to baseline for most p50/p95. Still monitoring for regression.

Ben P: I'll file follow-ups for permanent fixes (we shouldn't rely on manual max bumps). Proposed action items:
- INF-412: Increase autoscaler soft cap and add alert for "autoscaler at cap" (owner: Ben P)
- INF-413: Improve drain behavior to avoid cascading OOMs (owner: Sam)
- INF-414: On-call roster fix — add secondary for 02:00-04:00 PT (owner: Alice J)

Charlie O: I created INF-412 and INF-413 just now. Links: https://tracker.redwood/internal/INF-412, https://tracker.redwood/internal/INF-413

Eve S: scheduled retro for tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Invite sent to ops, eng-runtime, and oncall rotation (calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/retro-123). Agenda draft: timeline, root cause (OOM + cap), automations, runbook gaps.

Alice J: post-handoff notes (who's covering now):
- Primary: Charlie O (until 08:00 UTC)
- Secondary: Ben P (on-call for escalations)
- Coverage gap discovered: 02:00-04:00 PT — ticket INF-414 to fix calendar.
- Runbook pointer added to INF-412 as recommended reading.

Charlie O: leaving detailed follow-up in incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/2026-03-15-p1-infer-us-east (will update with logs and exact timeline).

Ben P: I'll own the post-mortem writeup with Sam. Target: EOD Friday.

Sam (SRE): temp changes (autoscale max, deploy lock) will be rolled back after retro unless action items land. I'll annotate infra change with rollback ETA: 7 days.

Alice J: action items summary (for handoff):
- Ben P: INF-412 autoscaler cap + alert (in progress)
- Sam: INF-413 drain behavior fix + infra rollback note
- Alice J: INF-414 roster correction + update oncall docs and add clear backup policy (complete after calendar)
- Charlie O: doc incident timeline & logs

Charlie O: closing the real-time thread — monitoring channel has suppression for alert 12345 for 30m to avoid noise. If regression, remove suppression and re-page.

incident-bot: note — suppression applied by Charlie O for alert 12345 (30m).

Eve S: thanks team. I'll follow up with customers and confirm they see normal behaviour. :thumbsup:

Alice J: handoff final: I'm now off primary — Charlie remains. Ben please cover any escalations. Follow-ups tracked in tracker links above.

Charlie O: acknowledged. I'll monitor until 08:00 UTC and update if anything changes.

[thread closed]
